about: The signing certificate of each app as INSTALLED on the owner's phones. Android installs a new APK over an old one only when both are signed by the same certificate, so every build is checked against these before it is handed out (scripts/release/releaseGuards.mjs). Read with apksigner from the four APKs built on 23 Sep 2026, which were copied to D:/my all projects/quick-bites-release-archive/2026-09-23 before any later build could overwrite them. Never edit a value to make a build pass: a different certificate means a different app to every phone that has this one.
